svg.title: Two-stage extraction with independent validation
svg.desc: Scans become source-linked text, then field candidates with provenance. Cross-page merging, rule validation and human review remain separate. Caches are tied to input and configuration versions.
svg.text: Stage 1: Transcribe faithfully; do not correct the source
Preserve labels, values, tables, line breaks, checkboxes and uncertainty
Link to source pages; retain coordinates and OCR confidence when available
Stage 2: Map evidence to field candidates
Apply schema meanings, types, enums and agreed normalization rules
Keep sources and versions; unreadable does not mean absent
Independent engineering steps: merge, validate, review
Do not overwrite cross-page conflicts; valid structure is not proof of correctness
Rule failure, insufficient evidence or conflicting candidates: human review
Version inputs and configuration; reuse model outputs, rescore against current assertions
